title: Omniscience of God
definition: Omniscience of God refers to what Scripture reveals about God's character, work, or relationship to His creation and His people.
summary: Omniscience of God refers to what Scripture reveals about God's character, work, or relationship to His creation and His people.
christFocus: Jesus makes this truth known most clearly by revealing the Father, accomplishing redemption, and bringing believers near to God through the Holy Spirit.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture reveals omniscience of God so believers can know God as He has made Himself known, not merely as human imagination, fear, or experience might describe Him. This truth belongs to worship before it becomes information.

This doctrine steadies God's people because His character is not shaped by changing circumstances. The Lord remains faithful, holy, wise, near, and sovereign even when life is confusing or painful.

Christ brings this truth near. In Him, God's character is not an abstract idea but saving reality. The believer comes to know God through the Son and learns to trust Him by the power of the Holy Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People often build their view of God from disappointment, religious pressure, family wounds, or fear. Scripture corrects those distorted pictures and calls believers to know the Lord according to His own revelation.

A clear view of omniscience of God helps the wounded, the recovering, the overlooked, and the teacher stand on truth rather than emotion or assumption. It gives worship a firm foundation.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let Scripture reshape how you think about God in this area. Bring false assumptions, fears, and shallow ideas to Christ, and ask the Holy Spirit to teach you to trust, worship, obey, and rest in the God who has revealed Himself.
